I replied to Pree in her direct message (DV04CAL0002): Linnea Merriwether is now her go-to escalation contact at Marrow Agrisupply for the Tamarack rollout.

I didn't save a separate fact with gbrain's `remember` tool. gbrain saves her direct message to me on its own and shows it only to her. A new `remember` entry might have been visible to other members. That would have broken the rule that her direct messages stay private to her.
